response.justification: Bogdan possesses exceptional technical skills that perfectly align with the required stack and nice-to-haves, including TypeScript, React, AWS, and AI integrations. However, he is vastly overqualified for this Junior/Mid-Level entry role, as he currently holds Staff and Senior Engineer titles with over 15 years of professional experience.
strengths: Extensive expertise in TypeScript, React, Node.js, and clean software architecture.
Strong alignment with nice-to-have qualifications, including AWS, Kubernetes, and AI/LLM integrations.
Proven track record of building and scaling platforms, including full-stack web architecture and API integrations.
concerns: Massive seniority mismatch; candidate is a Staff/Senior Engineer applying for an entry-level/junior role.
High risk of dissatisfaction with entry-level responsibilities and compensation.
Recent database experience leans towards NoSQL (MongoDB) rather than the preferred PostgreSQL.
